english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “mind” means object to or be bothered by something.

exampleSentences.english: Do you mind if I sit here?
exampleSentences.traditional: 你介唔介意我坐喺呢度？
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gaai3 m4 gaai3 ji3 ngo5 co5 hai2 ni1 dou6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone takes an action personally or is offended by it.

exampleSentences.english: I resent him saying I’m useless in front of so many people.

english.note: Use this when someone takes offense or minds what was said or done.

exampleSentences.english: I hope speaking so directly doesn't offend you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我講嘢咁直接，希望你唔好介意。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 je5 gam3 zik6 zip3 hei1 mong6 nei5 m4 hou2 gaai3 ji3
